about: Log 396 held-out set, written 2026-10-09 before any run. Controls carry qualifiers about the user's data (rare tissue, small or pediatric cohort, organoids, a mouse model) that read like demands on the method; near misses change one attribute or ask a function next to a single workflow.

items.core: protein domain annotation
items.prompt: We predicted 800 novel protein-coding genes in a newly sequenced fungus. We want to annotate their protein domains and assign them to known families.

items.core: tumor purity and ploidy estimates
items.prompt: From whole-genome sequencing of 40 tumor-normal pairs, we want to estimate each tumor's purity and ploidy before calling subclonal events.

items.core: A-to-I RNA editing sites
items.prompt: We have deep RNA-seq from 24 brain samples. We want to detect A-to-I RNA editing sites and compare editing levels between regions.

items.core: a Bayesian hierarchical dose-response model
items.prompt: We measured cell viability across eight drug doses in 30 cell lines. We want a Bayesian hierarchical dose-response model with IC50 estimates per line.

items.core: lncRNA-protein interaction predictions
items.prompt: We want to predict which RNA-binding proteins physically interact with each of 300 long non-coding RNAs from their sequences.

items.core: enhancer activity predicted from DNA sequence
items.prompt: We want to train a deep learning model that predicts enhancer activity from DNA sequence alone, using our MPRA measurements as labels.

items.core: codon usage indices
items.prompt: For all coding genes of a bacterial genome, we want codon adaptation indices and to test whether highly expressed genes use optimal codons.

items.core: cell segmentation of multiplexed imaging
items.prompt: We have multiplexed immunofluorescence images of 40 tumor sections. We want to segment cells and quantify marker intensity per cell.

items.core: a regulatory network for each single cell
items.prompt: From CITE-seq of 9,000 blood cells with motif and protein interaction priors, we want a TF-gene regulatory network for every single cell.

items.core: lncRNAs as regulators
items.prompt: For our pediatric leukemia cohort, we want a regulatory network in which long non-coding RNAs act as regulators of protein-coding genes.

items.core: a signed network for each tumor separately
items.prompt: With expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 48 tumors, we want a signed activating-or-repressing TF-gene network for each tumor separately.

items.core: one network over methylation, expression and microbiome
items.prompt: For 65 colon samples we have methylation, host expression and microbiome abundances. We want one partial-correlation network linking all three jointly.

items.core: communities of a protein co-abundance network
items.prompt: We built a protein co-abundance network from plasma proteomics. We want to split this protein-protein network into communities.

items.core: TF binding motifs learned from the network
items.prompt: After building our TF-gene network, we want to learn new DNA binding motifs for each transcription factor from the targets the network assigns to it.

items.core: a time-lagged causal network
items.prompt: We sampled each patient weekly for ten weeks. We want a time-lagged causal network in which a regulator's change predicts its targets' change the following week.

items.core: the refined protein-protein interaction network as an output
items.prompt: With expression, a motif prior and a protein interaction network for 100 samples, we want the refined protein-protein interaction network PANDA learns, saved as an output.

items.core: patient subtypes from expression profiles
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq expression for 280 tumors and no mutation data. We want pathway-based patient subtypes computed from the expression profiles.

items.core: single-gene differential expression tests
items.prompt: With a design matrix of disease status and age for 160 samples, we want a test of which individual genes are differentially expressed by disease status.

items.core: forecasting disease progression
items.prompt: For a rare disease we have expression from 18 patients plus motif and protein interaction priors. We want one TF-gene network, and then to forecast each patient's progression.

items.core: identifying causal driver genes
items.prompt: We have expression for 36 patients and no priors. We want a co-expression network for each patient, and then to identify the genes that causally drive their disease.

items.core: adding a third (microbiome) layer to the same model
items.prompt: We have methylation and expression for 70 samples. We want a two-layer partial-correlation network, and then to add microbiome abundances as a third layer in the same model.

items.core: cell-type deconvolution
items.prompt: We have mutation calls and bulk expression for 200 tumors. We want mutation-based patient subtypes, and then each tumor's cell-type composition from the expression.

items.core: single-cell resolution of TF activity
items.prompt: From bulk expression of 50 organoids with motif and protein interaction priors, we want each TF's activity per organoid, and then the same at single-cell resolution.

items.core: a TF-gene network for a rare tissue
items.prompt: We have only a few RNA-seq samples from a rare tissue, plus public motif and protein interaction data. We want to infer a TF-gene regulatory network for this tissue.

items.core: per-patient TF-gene networks for a small pediatric cohort
items.prompt: For our small pediatric cohort of 25 patients with motif and protein interaction priors, we want a TF-gene network for each patient.

items.core: signed TF regulation in zebrafish liver
items.prompt: Using zebrafish liver expression with zebrafish motif and protein interaction priors, we want to know which transcription factors activate and which repress their targets.

items.core: a TF and miRNA network for a rare cancer subtype
items.prompt: For a rare cancer subtype we have expression of 30 tumors, motif and protein interaction priors and miRNA target predictions. We want one TF and miRNA regulatory network.

items.core: communities of a TF-gene network from a mouse model
items.prompt: We built a TF-gene regulatory network from a mouse model of fibrosis. We want communities of regulators and target genes and the core regulators of each.

items.core: a partial-correlation network between metabolites and lipids
items.prompt: We measured metabolites and lipids in the same 120 plasma samples. We want one network of direct associations between metabolites and lipids with edge p-values.

items.core: co-expression associated with disease status adjusting for batch
items.prompt: We want the gene-gene co-expression explained by disease status in our 190 samples, adjusting for sequencing batch in a design matrix.

items.core: per-patient co-expression networks for a rare disease
items.prompt: For 20 patients with a rare disease we have only expression data. We want a gene co-expression network for each patient.

items.core: pathway-level mutation subtypes for a rare tumor type
items.prompt: We have somatic mutation calls for 90 tumors of a rare type. We want patient subtypes from pathway-level mutation scores.

items.core: a low-memory TF-gene network for a large cohort
items.prompt: Memory is tight on our cluster, but we need one TF-gene network for 600 samples from expression, a motif prior and a protein interaction network.

items.core: per-patient methylation-expression networks for an orphan disease
items.prompt: For 40 patients with an orphan disease we measured methylation and expression. We want a methylation-expression partial-correlation network for each patient.

items.core: TF activity per organoid
items.prompt: We have bulk expression from 60 intestinal organoids with motif and protein interaction priors. We want each TF's activity in each organoid.
